A patch release before the Forge Desk rename.

## Fixes

- **The login page follows your theme.** The login page uses the Light or Dark theme you picked in the app's theme menu, including right after **Log out**. With **Match system**, or when the browser blocks storage, it follows the system setting as before. ([#82](https://github.com/brunoorsolon/forge-desk/issues/82))

## New

- **The running version is in the app.** The bottom of the theme menu shows the version of the server you are connected to, for example `2.0.1`. `GET /api/settings` also reports it as `version`.

## Upgrading from 2.0.0

Nothing to change. Sessions live in memory, so you log in again after the upgrade.
